_comment: Source text each translation is measured against. A difference between a translation and this text that matches a reading in another edition (RP, WH, SBLGNT) is classified as a textual-base difference, not as a fidelity error.

WEB.evidence: WEB NT follows the Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine Majority Text; OT is based on Biblia Hebraica Stuttgartensia (digital text: ETCBC BHSA), which differs from WLC in Genesis by 16 ketiv/qere-type letters.

BSB.evidence: BSB OT: Westminster Leningrad Codex. BSB NT draws on NA, SBLGNT and ECM; this study uses SBLGNT only (to be stated in the article).

OEB.evidence: OEB OT: Westminster digital copy of the Leningrad Codex (WLC). OEB NT: revision of the Twentieth Century New Testament conformed to Westcott-Hort.

SPS.evidence: Stated by the translator: WLC for Hebrew, SBLGNT for Greek.
